_comment: Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B screening set: the 4 physics-flavoured prompts of wan_set.json x 1 seed at a 1 s horizon (17 frames, 480x832: the smallest size at which the model produces coherent video; see models/cosmos_predict.py). `prompt` must be one of the embeddings made by scripts/encode_cosmos_prompts.py (the defaults match these). Quality is agreement with the unoptimized model's video for the same seed (CosmosReferenceScenarios), NOT physics. Each rollout is ~113 s on a 12 GB laptop GPU, so this is a 4-clip screen: confirm anything promising on more prompts before believing it.

prompts.prompt: A red ball rolls down a wooden ramp and bounces on the floor.
Water is poured from a pitcher into a glass on a kitchen counter.
A robot arm picks up a red cube from a table and places it into a bin.
A car drives through a busy four-way intersection while pedestrians cross the street.
